ENCOUNTERS.notes: Temporary removed, margins clean. Permanent zirconia crown cemented on 16. Occlusion checked and adjusted.
Supra- and subgingival scaling completed. Light staining on lower anteriors polished out. Aligner tray fit reviewed.

ENCOUNTERS.chief_complaint: Chipped upper left central incisor after cycling fall
ENCOUNTERS.notes: Enamel-only fracture on 21, no pulp exposure. Composite build-up placed and polished. Sensitivity advice given.
Exposed cervical dentine on 24 and 25. Desensitising varnish applied. Advised soft brush and non-abrasive paste.
Partially erupted 48 with pericoronitis. Irrigated, oral hygiene instruction given, antibiotics prescribed. OPG requested.
Pressure point at left lingual flange relieved. Patient comfortable on re-seat. Review in three weeks.

ENCOUNTERS.chief_complaint: Progressive blurring, right worse than left
ENCOUNTERS.notes: Nuclear sclerotic cataract grade 3 right, grade 1 left. Biometry booked. Listed for right phacoemulsification.

ENCOUNTERS.chief_complaint: Red, gritty right eye for two days
ENCOUNTERS.notes: Diffuse conjunctival injection, no corneal staining. Contact lens wear suspended for one week.
Pressures stable on latanoprost. Fields unchanged from last year. Continue current therapy.
Excoriated, lichenified plaques bilaterally. Stepped up to a potent topical steroid for two weeks, then taper.
Well-demarcated scaly plaques along the hairline. Started ketoconazole shampoo and a scalp application.

LAB_ORDERS.note: Recurrent gingivitis — screen for glucose intolerance.
